SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_BiggestH.en: The biggest HERACROSS that I have\never seen measured so far is:\p{STR_VAR_3} inches!
SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_BiggestH.fr: Le plus grand SCARHINO que j'aie\njamais mesuré jusqu'ici est de :\p{STR_VAR_3} pouces !

SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_BlankCha.en: It's a blank chart of some sort.\pIt has spaces for writing in\nrecords of some kind.
SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_BlankCha.fr: C'est un classement vierge.\pIl y a de la place pour inscrire\ndes records.

SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_ItsXInch.en: Eeeek, it's {STR_VAR_2} inches!\nI've never seen anything like this!\lYou deserve a reward!
SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_ItsXInch.fr: Iiiih, il fait {STR_VAR_2} pouces ! Je\nn'ai jamais rien vu de tel ! Tu\lmérites une récompense !

SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_ItsXInch.en: Huh? This {STR_VAR_2}-inch measurement…\nOh, boo! It's the same as before.
SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_ItsXInch.fr: Hein ? Cette mesure de {STR_VAR_2}\npouces… Oh, zut ! C'est la même\lqu'avant.

SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_ItsXInch.en: Oh, it's just {STR_VAR_2} inches.\nThe HERACROSS before was bigger.\pIt was {STR_VAR_3} inches, the biggest\nHERACROSS you've brought me.
SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_ItsXInch.fr: Oh, ça fait que {STR_VAR_2} pouces.\nLe SCARHINO d'avant était plus\lgrand.\pIl faisait {STR_VAR_3} pouces, le plus\ngrand SCARHINO que tu m'aies\lapporté.

SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_LoveItNe.en: Hera, hera, HERACROSS!\nBig and shiny, it's the bug boss!\lLove it, need it, HERACROSS!
SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_LoveItNe.fr: Héra, héra, SCARHINO ! Grand et\nbrillant, c'est le boss des\linsectes ! Je l'adore, j'en ai\nbesoin, SCARHINO !

SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_MayIMeas.en: Eeeeek!\nThat's a HERACROSS!\pPlease, please, may I measure how\nbig it is?
SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_MayIMeas.fr: Iiiiih !\nC'est un SCARHINO !\pS'il te plaît, puis-je mesurer sa\ntaille ?

SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_ThisWont.en: Oh, no! This won't do!\pHERACROSS looks much more macho\nand cool, and has a lovely horn!
SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_ThisWont.fr: Oh non ! Ça va pas !\pSCARHINO a l'air bien plus viril\net cool, et il a une belle corne !

SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_WantToSe.en: I want to see a much, much bigger\nHERACROSS than that one.\pOh, how I adore them, big\nHERACROSS!
SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_WantToSe.fr: Je veux en voir un beaucoup plus\ngros que celui-là.\pOh, comme je les adore !

SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_YourBagI.en: Your BAG is full.\nMy reward won't fit.
SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_YourBagI.fr: Ton SAC est plein.\nMa récompense n'y rentrera pas.
